question: Can the M4T2 target-imagery calibration result AND its training-only quality signal replicate in COMPLETELY INDEPENDENT participants/data?

two_axes.A_CALIBRATION: does exact M4T2 direct target-state estimator again meet the historical operational sufficiency criterion in independent participants?
two_axes.B_QUALITY_MONITOR: can instability be detected using ONLY the 8 observations of an M4T2 acquisition itself, before held-out outcomes?

stage0_audit.inspect: metadata / task structure / file manifests ONLY

per_participant_requires: target imagery from enough distinct identities
>=4 calibration identities with >=2 imagery repeats each
>=2 held-out imagery identities not in calibration
enough imagery to build participant native reference + capacity reference (TOTAL_RECOVERY, FULL_CAPACITY_FRACTION)
native or certified ROI for BOTH ventral and lateral
task provenance for identity+repeat without outcome inspection

direct_vs_conceptual.prefer: DIRECT_REPLICATION (task/data supports historical estimator without method change)
direct_vs_conceptual.if_requires_substantive_change: issue NO_ELIGIBLE_DIRECT_REPLICATION_DATASET + document candidates/reasons; a conceptual replication is a SEPARATELY frozen gate; no silent adaptation

no_auto_external_download: the one-time O2.13 S3 authorization does NOT extend to O2.16; use accessible/public data when permitted; if new credentials/paid storage/paid compute/special authorization needed -> document blocker, do not infer permission

model.estimator: EXACT O2.9 direct target-state; M=4, T=2, 8 observations; within q=min(r_best,4) direct SVD; outside D=2; no Procrustes/perception-prior/anatomy-behavior-prior/new-estimator
model.identity_families: if exact structure available use 2 simple + 2 nat calibration + family-balanced held-out; if exact labels absent -> prospectively defensible homologous grouping from task metadata frozen before outcomes, else NOT a direct dataset; NO outcome-derived category mapping

m4t2_replication_criterion: M4T2_OPERATIONAL_REPLICATION_PASS (per ROI) iff ALL: every required participant evaluable; median clipped TOTAL_RECOVERY>=0.50; >=ceil(0.75*N) participants TOTAL>=0.50; median clipped FULL_CAPACITY_FRACTION>=0.50; >=ceil(0.75*N) FCF>=0.50 (no new p-value for resource criterion)

quality_monitor.CRITICAL_CHANGE: O2.15 used 2-vs-6 (not available in a real 8-observation M4T2 acquisition); O2.16 MUST use REPEAT-A vs REPEAT-B geometry from the same 4 identities (computable from the M4T2 acquisition itself, no extra imagery)
quality_monitor.P_IN_A/B: z_{A/B}_i = W_target.T delta_trial(i, repeat_{A/B}); stack 4 identities; q=min(r_best,4); deterministic SVD
quality_monitor.P_OUT_A/B: o=delta-W(W.T delta); stack 4; D=2; deterministic SVD
quality_monitor.Q_MON_COMP: (q*Q_MON_IN + 2*Q_MON_OUT)/(q+2) DESCRIPTIVE only; primary = IN and OUT separately; do NOT drop IN because OUT stronger historically

no_quality_threshold_yet: O2.15 established a CONTINUOUS relation, not a validated cutoff; O2.16 does NOT retrospectively choose a good-Q threshold from historical cohort; external replication first tests the continuous relationship; a later gate may freeze an adaptive threshold on a THIRD cohort

schedule_set.if_multiple_M4T2_schedules: evaluate ALL prospectively valid M4T2 schedules per participant; no sampling; no best schedule
schedule_set.if_single_schedule: M4T2 operational replication still testable but within-participant schedule-correlation monitor -> QUALITY_MONITOR_INCONCLUSIVE_FROM_DATA_STRUCTURE; do NOT invent pseudo-schedules

quality_association.per_participant_roi: Spearman(Q_MON_{IN/OUT}, ROBUSTNESS_MARGIN) across valid schedules; Fisher-z average over predefined folds when folds exist; no schedule is inferential N

quality_inference.family: 2 components x 2 ROIs = EXACTLY 4 tests (independent participants only)
quality_inference.signflip: exact one-sided 2^N if practical; else frozen deterministic Monte-Carlo sign-flip >=1,000,000 patterns with frozen seed

quality_monitor_pass: QUALITY_MONITOR_REPLICATED (component x ROI) iff ALL: median participant rho>0; >=75% participants rho>0; Holm reject (no rho-magnitude threshold)

fragility_replication.if_multiple_schedules: report independent SCHEDULE_COVERAGE (exact O2.14 sufficiency); compare descriptively to historical ventral 0.656 / lateral 0.579; failure need NOT reproduce for M4T2 average calibration to replicate

roi_status.M4T2_AND_QUALITY_MONITOR_REPLICATED: M4T2 pass AND Q_MON_IN AND Q_MON_OUT replicate
roi_status.M4T2_REPLICATED_QUALITY_MONITOR_PARTIAL: M4T2 pass, only one component replicates

program_status.INDEPENDENT_REPLICATION_PARTIAL: calibration and/or monitor replicate only partially across components/ROIs
program_status.INDEPENDENT_M4T2_REPLICATION_PASS_MONITO: M4T2 passes both ROIs but quality monitoring does not
program_status.INDEPENDENT_FAILURE_MODE_REPLICATION_PAS: monitor passes both ROIs but M4T2 operational does not
program_status.INDEPENDENT_REPLICATION_NOT_CONFIRMED: adequate confirmatory data but neither main finding replicates

claim_boundaries.positive: in an independent cohort, the prospectively frozen M4T2 direct target-state calibration again closed >=half of the prespecified native-oracle and full-capacity gaps in both primary ROIs, and repeat-to-repeat geometry agreement computed solely from the 8 calibration observations prospectively predicted held-out calibration success
claim_boundaries.positive_also: the acquisition-quality signal generalized beyond the original development cohort
positive_forbidden: repeat instability is a biological mechanism
claim_boundaries.negative_m4t2: the historical 8-observation result did not satisfy the prospectively frozen operational replication criterion in the independent cohort
claim_boundaries.negative_monitor: the repeat-to-repeat geometry monitor derived from the O2.15 failure mode did not prospectively generalize

outcome_access_seal.STAGE_A: certify cohort + freeze participants + task/ROI mappings + construct calibration states + M4T2 fits + Q_MON + hash fitted projectors + commit/push/verify; NO held-out imagery outcome; token O2_16_EXTERNAL_STAGE_A_SEALED
outcome_access_seal.STAGE_B: after Stage-A verify: verify hashes; open held-out external imagery; operational recovery; robustness margins; participant quality associations; exact 4-test Holm; replication classification; seal

pre_outcome_technical_tests: no target test identity in calibration
no reuse of historical subjects in inference

historical_software_replay.purpose: run frozen O2.16 implementation on historical O2.15 state as SOFTWARE REPLAY only
historical_software_replay.label: SOFTWARE_COMPATIBILITY_REPLAY_ONLY

optional_historical_qmon.label: POST_FREEZE_DEVELOPMENT_COHORT_DESCRIPTION
optional_historical_qmon.allowed: compute 1-vs-1 Q_MON on historical participants AFTER formula frozen to verify non-degeneracy

next_gate.FULL_PASS: O2.17 PROSPECTIVE QUALITY-GATED ACQUISITION PROTOCOL (derive/freeze Q threshold or reacquisition rule from dev+replication; validate on a THIRD cohort)
next_gate.M4T2_PASS_MONITOR_FAIL: O2.17 REPLICATION-STABLE CALIBRATION WITHOUT QUALITY GATING
next_gate.MONITOR_PASS_M4T2_FAIL: O2.17 RESOURCE ESCALATION WITH FROZEN QUALITY MONITOR (extra repeats/identities restore sufficiency?)
next_gate.NOT_CONFIRMED: O2.17 CROSS-DATASET FAILURE ANALYSIS (diagnose task/acquisition/cohort/reference differences; no immediate retune)
next_gate.DATA_UNAVAILABLE: O2.16-DATA NEW REPLICATION ACQUISITION PROTOCOL (data-collection protocol for genuinely new participants; do NOT replace external replication with more N=8 analysis)

O3_policy: O3 remains O3_NOT_READY even after successful O2.16; replication strengthens the representational program but does not establish causal computation / universal operator / thought manipulation / cross-subject native-state identity; a future O3 gate needs its OWN frozen prerequisites
